summary: Multi-tenant query without org_id filter — RLS-bypass risk + full-table scan.

findings.message: SELECT on shared-tenant invoices table has no WHERE org_id = ... predicate. If this SQL runs under a role that has BYPASSRLS (superuser, migration runner, some pg_dump paths), it returns every tenant's data. This is the exact silent-leak pattern.
findings.suggestion: Add `AND org_id = %s` to the WHERE clause and take org_id as an explicit function argument. Never rely on RLS alone for tenant scoping in application code.

findings.message: No LIMIT — full-table scan across all tenants. On a 10M-row invoices table this OOMs the worker.
findings.suggestion: Paginate via keyset (WHERE (due_date, id) < (:last_due, :last_id) LIMIT 500) or add a bounded LIMIT.
